info.title: MapleSpike API
info.description: Canadian public-sector data API. Coverage and response fields vary by endpoint and source. Where supplied, Quill record hashes support integrity comparisons but do not establish source authenticity or reuse rights. Publisher terms vary by dataset; consult the original source. Software license declarations vary by repository artifact; see https://github.com/reverb256/quill/blob/main/docs/open-source-audit.md.

get.summary: Look up a claim hash
get.description: A hash match checks canonical record integrity only. Provenance evidence and source retrieval time are available only when recorded; this lookup does not authenticate the source or establish reuse rights.

200.description: Claim hash lookup and available evidence

get.summary: List recent claim summaries
get.description: Public discovery index. Source retrieval timestamps may be null when acquisition evidence was not recorded.

200.description: Recent claim summaries

post.description: Recomputes SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the supplied value and optionally compares a claimed hash. This checks value integrity, not source authenticity or reuse rights.

200.description: Recomputed canonical-record hash and comparison result

QuillResponse.description: Common API envelope. Payload and citation fields vary by route and source.

data.description: Route-specific payload; shape varies by endpoint.

ClaimVerificationData.description: Stored or indexed record hash match and evidence when available.

retrieved_at.description: Source acquisition time; null when not recorded.

claim_created_at.description: Quill claim registration time, not source retrieval time.

license.description: Publisher metadata or a notice to consult source terms; not a reuse grant.

retrieved_at.description: Source acquisition time; null when not recorded.

claim_created_at.description: Quill claim registration time, not source retrieval time.

created_at.description: Legacy alias for claim registration time.

verified.description: True only when an optional claimed hash matches the recomputed canonical JSON hash.

timestamp.description: API response timestamp, not source retrieval time.

retrieved_at.description: Source acquisition time only when observed.

data_hash.description: For claim records, SHA-256 of canonical Quill record JSON, not upstream response bytes.

license.description: Publisher metadata or a notice to consult source terms; not a reuse grant.

ProvenanceEvidence.description: Evidence inventory only; it does not establish source identity, completeness, or reuse rights.
